sentences.en: Patients often die simply because they yield to their diseases.
sentences.zh: 病人往往因为屈服于疾病而死去。

sentences.en: Eating too much fat is supposed to cause heart disease.
sentences.zh: 吃太多脂肪据说会导致心脏病。

sentences.en: At present it is medically impossible to cure this disease.
sentences.zh: 目前医学上无法治愈这种病。
